method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: One panorama about 6.7 m from the facade, resected on both corners of the cottage; its base row puts the camera 2.15 m high. The eaves stand at 2.78 m, far below the district height of 6.65. The dormers stand 0.6 m in from the wall line on a lower roof slope of about 56 degrees, which meets the upper roof at 6.1 m; the upper roof, the chimney height and the yard side are estimates.
